What’s new in downtown Santa Rosa? A little more color, creativity, and connection. 🎨 The new Santa Rosa Public Art Walk is doing just that by connecting downtown Santa Rosa to Historic Railroad Square with nine large-scale sculptures on display from November 2025 through August 2027. Centered around the theme Urban Renewal, this program invites artists to breathe new life into our cityscape and transform public spaces into places of reflection and inspiration.  

Led by the City’s Arts and Culture Coordinator, Meredith Knudsen, this project fosters civic pride, supports artists, and celebrates Santa Rosa’s identity as a vibrant, ever-evolving community. Because here, art is just one of the many things to enjoy in Santa Rosa.
